learning_outcomes.text: Use of fundamental knowledge in electrotechnics.
Diagnosis, troubleshooting and maintenance of electrical systems and components.
Structure, characteristics and operation of semiconductor devices.
Use of linear models on portions of electronic devices to solve circuits.
Design and operation of simple electronic circuits with diodes, bipolar transistors, field effect transistors, thyristors, operational amplifiers.

Developing a positive attitude towards the activities of assimilating new professional knowledge and information, cultivating and promoting a scientific environment focused on values, forming a positive and responsible professional behavior.

syllabus_topics: Bipolar Diodes - pn semiconductor diode, Zener diode, varicap diode, LED (symbol, internal structure, characteristic V-A, characteristic parameters).
Bipolar transistor I - General; Operation in the active region: characteristics, equivalent circuits, operating parameters, polarization.
Bipolar transistor II - Blocking and saturation operation: characteristics, equivalent circuits, operating parameters.
Bipolar transistor III - Model with hybrid parameters: definition of parameters, equivalent circuits, diagrams with a transistor in different assemblies, simplified model.
Thyristor - Symbol, internal structure, V-A characteristic, operating parameters
Field effect transistors I - General; TEC-J with initial channel and with induced channel (symbol, characteristic and operating parameters).
Field effect transistors II - TEC-MOS with initial channel and with induced channel (symbol, characteristic and operating parameters).

Operational amplifiers - General (symbol, characteristics and operating parameters).Applications: inverter and non-inverter circuits, adder, differentiation circuit, derivative circuit, integrator, logarithmic circuit, precision rectifier.
Diode rectifier circuits - Mono-alternating, bi-alternating (with median socket, in bridge), with voltage doubling: schemes, mode and operating characteristics.
Transistor Voltage Stabilizers - Schemes with transistors and operational amplifier, with and without protection circuit.
Study of the semiconductor and Zener diodes
Bipolar transistor in common base and common emitter assembly
Mono-alternating and double- alternating rectifier circuits
Recovery of laboratories.Ending the school situation.

assessment_methods.method: Course evaluation (oral or written, online or on-site)
Laboratory evaluation (written test, practical test, discussions, online or on-site argumentation)

assessment_rules: Minimum performance standard requires obtaining a grade of 5 in each laboratory test, participation and fulfillment of all requirements imposed by each laboratory work, and obtaining a grade of 5 in the course tests as an arithmetic mean of grades obtained. A percentage of 15% of the final grade at the laboratory is awarded for the successful completion of all topics provided for individual study.
